# LineJoin

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Line join style for stroke corners.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Drawing`.

## Values

- `Miter`: Miter join (sharp corner, clipped at miter limit).
- `Round`: Round join (circular arc at the corner).
- `Bevel`: Bevel join (straight line across the corner).
